purpose: read-only review evidence; no RPM or audibility verdict

method.audio_preprocessing: None for edge measurements; per-window channel means removed only for spectral/period analysis
method.unusual_boundary_flag: abs(first-last) > max(0.08 FS, 3.5 * interior abs-step p99.9), uncalibrated review cue only; runtime uses a conservative histogram upper bound instead of exact quantile
method.periods: Nine evenly placed one-second windows (may overlap; not independent evidence); overlap-energy-normalized autocorrelation, 20–800 Hz lag search; top three positive peaks per window, clustered within 0.04 octave
method.spectrum: Average channel-power Hann periodograms over the same windows; strongest 20–4000 Hz local peaks, at least 5 Hz apart; zero padding interpolates but does not improve 1 Hz physical resolution
method.scope: Native file wrap only; runtime resampling, sample gains, crossfades, limiter and perceived Tesla audio are not measured

period_analysis.uncertainty: Candidates may be harmonics, subharmonics, firing, shaft, exhaust, or transmission components; cylinder/order metadata and listening are required.

seam_candidate.method: Complementary raised-cosine tail/head blend in the decoded tail; loop starts after the head; coefficients sum to one
seam_candidate.limitations: Changes loop duration and phase; can cause short local cancellation; no repeat-listening or resampled runtime render yet.
